{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative bias (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00 in recent days) and model overestimates.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show mean reversion toward lower levels after a spike.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive (0.00), to avoid underestimating rebound potential.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast 3-5 days ago, adjust current forecast downward by 3-7%.",
    "Avoid over-optimism after sharp price spikes: if model forecasts a spike followed by a sharp drop, reduce peak forecast by 10-15% to prevent overshoot.",
    "When sentiment history includes a recent 0.50 (positive sentiment), increase forecast by 2-5% to reflect bullish momentum, but cap at 10% above prior peak.",
    "If model consistently underestimates true outcomes in the 3rd-5th day of the 30-day horizon, apply a 3-5% upward bias correction for that period."
  ]
}
